material_acceptance_points: PWY-5415 is the hydrolytic five-step parent of P183-PWY and PWY-5162, distinct from seven-step oxidative PWY-5420.
Native 3.7.1.9-RXN forms the explicit 2Z enol CPD-14447; Rhea family14549 forms keto CHEBI:11641. Do not replace the native reaction with its Rhea cross-reference.
RHEA:22582 is the R2L family member. Native reversible aldolase and dehydrogenase annotations remain distinct from selected L2R pathway flux.

PMID8419288 supports positive NADH and weaker NAD+ effects on complex-associated DmpG activity, Mn stimulation, and Zn inhibition. It leaves obligatory Mn requirement and precise nucleotide-binding/allosteric mechanism unresolved. Native REG-5876 has the wrong negative sign relative to this experiment.
DmpFG biological unit has two DmpF and two DmpG; the catalytic heterodimer and crystal asymmetric unit are distinct. Native component coefficients agree, though native prose calls it a heterodimer.

CNB-1 native ENZRXN-16329 unchlorinated assignment conflicts with its cited protein prose, which only reports a chlorinated conversion by coexpressed cnbE/cnbF. The assignment may remain bounded database context but cannot support isolated-protein unchlorinated experimental catalysis.
Bilophila AdhE assay material was His-tagged recombinant protein in E. coli; preserve subject qualifiers and pH8 versus pH7.5 activity scope.
TbuE1991 pRO1985 crude extract and1996 pRO1986+pRO2345 partially purified preparations are separate. Native ENZRXN-11552 methylcatechol chemistry is not formal catechol-reaction identity.
1989 single XylJ activity and2004 engineered complex-only wording must remain preparation-scoped; no universal complex requirement follows.
PWY-5162 explicitly excludes ADHE-CPLX. Shared acetaldehyde dehydrogenase sources from other biological pathways are component/adjacent evidence and cannot add whole-route organisms.

Parent species slots have no individual evidence entries. The parent PMID1856161 assay concerns donorPKO1/recombinant host experiments, not full-route experimental confirmation for every native taxon annotation.
